title: Light Crunchy Moroccan Lentil Skillet
description: A flavorful and crunchy Moroccan lentil dish made with tamarind paste and pickle, perfect for a solo dinner, featuring a mix of grassy notes and crunchy textures in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red lentils, tamarind paste, and chopped pickle, and stir to combine.
Cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the mixture is lightly browned.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the lentil mixture hot, straight from the skillet.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
